help.title: Help
help.description: How to use the SATYA-EoA workbench prototype.
help.heading: Help
help.whatBody: SATYA-EoA checks Extension of Approval applications sent by the mock approval portal and shows advisory findings with evidence, the rule applied and the APH clause. It never approves, rejects or clears anything. An official records every decision.
help.labelsBody: Every document shows exactly one label, always as text: Verified, Mismatch detected, Expired, Verification pending, Source unavailable, Manual review required.
help.riskBody: High, Medium or Low orders the review queue only. It is not a finding and is never shown to the institution.
help.dataBody: All applications, institutions and people are synthetic. Source checks marked MOCK SOURCE come from mock adapters, and demo signatures chain to a TEST TRUST ANCHOR.
help.keysBody: Press Tab to move, Enter to follow a link or press a button, and Escape to close the menu. The first Tab on every page offers a link that skips to the main content.

accessibility.title: Accessibility statement
accessibility.description: Accessibility statement for the SATYA-EoA workbench prototype (WCAG 2.1 AA, GIGW 3.0).
accessibility.heading: Accessibility statement
accessibility.commitment: We build the SATYA-EoA workbench to be usable by everyone, including people who use a keyboard, a screen reader, magnification or high-contrast settings.
accessibility.standardsBody: Target: WCAG 2.1 level AA and the Guidelines for Indian Government Websites (GIGW 3.0).
accessibility.feature1: A skip link and one main heading on every page
accessibility.feature2: Full keyboard operation with a visible focus outline
accessibility.feature3: Text can be resized to 200% without loss of content
accessibility.feature4: Every status is written as text, never shown by colour alone
accessibility.feature5: Animations are turned off when your system asks for reduced motion
accessibility.limitsBody: This is a prototype. Hindi text is still being reviewed by a native speaker, and a full audit with assistive technology is planned before any pilot.
accessibility.reportBody: Report accessibility problems to Team OneVision through the project's issue tracker.

about.title: About
about.heading: About SATYA-EoA
about.body1: SATYA-EoA is the missing first-pass scrutiny for self-disclosure Extension of Approval, and an evidence assistant for every committee after it.
about.body2: It reads AICTE's own templates the way they were designed, checks each document at its official source where one exists, and reconciles sworn claims against portal data and past years. Findings are advisory; officials decide.
about.body3: This prototype runs against a mock approval portal built by the team, on synthetic data only. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to AICTE.

policies.title: Policies
policies.description: Privacy, cookie, security and use policies for the SATYA-EoA prototype.
policies.heading: Policies
policies.privacyBody: The prototype holds synthetic data only. It stores no real names, contact details, identity numbers or documents.
policies.cookiesBody: Two kinds of cookie are set: a secure, HTTP-only session cookie after you sign in, and a language cookie that remembers English or Hindi. No tracking or analytics cookies are used.
policies.securityBody: All traffic uses HTTPS. Sign-in is handled by the single sign-on service; this application never sees or stores your password.
policies.useBody: The workbench gives advisory findings to support officials. Statutory scrutiny, inspections and final decisions stay with the competent authorities.

diff.title: Affidavit diff
diff.description: Sworn Affidavit 2 compared with the portal draft and the Application Report for case …{case}. Advisory, synthetic data.
diff.heading: Affidavit diff
diff.advisory: Advisory findings for review. An official records every decision; nothing on this page changes the application's status.
diff.expectedHeading: Expected: portal draft for this application
diff.signaturesPending: Issuer and uploader signature checks arrive with M6 (P-4).
diff.categoryLine: Category line in the opening block
diff.extraBlocks: Blocks the draft does not print
diff.normalisation: Normalised before comparing: whitespace and line breaks, {hyphens} hyphen-wrapped words re-joined, {struck} struck-through words removed (the choice left standing counts), institution names and IDs substituted. Dates are read as {order}.
diff.changesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No declaration differs} one {# declaration differs} other {# declarations differ}} from the {total} in the draft.
diff.noChanges: Every declaration matches the portal draft after normalisation.
diff.tablesIntro: Each cell shows the sworn value. Where it differs, the Application Report value is shown under it. Deed holder and document number are tokenised and masked; they are compared by token.
diff.computedTotal: Computed total (the portal leaves this row blank)
diff.duplicates: Used in more than one room table: {ids}
diff.stampPending: Stamp details, notarisation and the order application, stamp, notarisation, signature, upload are checked by M6 (P-4). They are not evaluated on this page yet.
diff.noFlags: No findings. The sworn copy matches the portal draft and the Application Report.
diff.dispositionPending: No disposition recorded yet. Officials record decisions with the decision bar (M11, P-10).
diff.stampStateNote: Format checks on the stamp page. The e-stamp lookup itself (mock source) arrives with M7 (P-5).
diff.noStamp: No stamp page was found in the text layer.
diff.orderRule: Expected: application date ≤ stamp issued ≤ notarised ≤ deponent signature ≤ uploaded.

verification.title: Verification
verification.description: Document verification for case …{case}: one label per document and two independent signature checks. Advisory, synthetic data.
verification.heading: Verification
verification.countsNote: Every document shows exactly one of the six labels, always as text.
verification.issuerProfilePending: Not profiled yet (Annexure-14 issuer profiles arrive with M3/M4, P-6)
verification.actionsNote: Re-check, route to manual verification and retry arrive with M11 (P-10). Suggested here: {actions}.
verification.checksSummary: {title}: {count, plural, one {# check} other {# checks}}, {flags, plural, =0 {no findings} one {# finding} other {# findings}}

reason.SIG_VALID: Real signature, intact, unchanged after signing, chains to the trust anchor, valid and not revoked at the signing time
reason.SIG_DIGEST_MISMATCH: The signed bytes no longer match the signature
reason.SIG_MODIFIED_AFTER_SIGNING: Content was changed after signing, beyond what a signature permits
reason.SIG_CERT_REVOKED: The signing certificate was revoked before the signing time
reason.SIG_CERT_EXPIRED: The signing certificate was expired or not yet valid at the signing time
reason.SIG_UNTRUSTED_CHAIN: The certificate does not chain to the trust anchor
reason.SIG_IMAGE_ONLY: A printed "digitally signed" mark with no real signature behind it
reason.SIG_SIGNER_NOT_MATCHED: Valid signature, but not by the authorised Chairman or Secretary
reason.SIG_REVOCATION_UNREACHABLE: The revocation list could not be fetched after retries
reason.SIG_NOT_DIGITAL: No digital signature by the issuer
reason.UPLOADER_DSC_MISSING: No institution signature on the uploaded file
reason.CHRONO_MARK_OK: Printed mark not dated after notarisation
reason.STAMP_PARTY_NOT_COUNCIL: Second Party is not the Council
reason.STAMP_NO_UNIQUE: Certificate number not seen on another filing
reason.STAMP_NO_REUSED: Certificate number already on another filing
reason.NOTARY_SEAL_VALID: Notary seal valid on the notarisation date
reason.UDIN_STRUCTURE_OK: UDIN has 18 characters in the expected structure
reason.UDIN_MALFORMED: UDIN is not in the expected structure
reason.UDIN_YEAR_OK: UDIN year fits the financial year audited
reason.UDIN_YEAR_BEFORE_FY_END: UDIN year does not fit the financial year audited
reason.UDIN_MEMBER_OK: Membership number in the UDIN matches the printed one
reason.UDIN_MEMBER_MISMATCH: Membership number in the UDIN differs from the printed one
reason.UDIN_UNIQUE: UDIN not seen on another filing
reason.SRC_NO_CHANNEL: No automated channel to the issuing source; a manual verification task is needed
reason.SRC_NO_IDENTIFIER: No identifier printed to look up; a manual verification task is needed

verification.legendHeading: How signatures map to the six labels

legend.verified: Real signature (/ByteRange) that chains to the {anchor}: VERIFIED
legend.mismatch: Chain broken, edited after signing or certificate revoked: MISMATCH DETECTED
legend.expired: Certificate expired or not yet valid at signing: EXPIRED
legend.manual: Image only, untrusted chain, or signer not the authorised Chairman or Secretary: MANUAL REVIEW REQUIRED
legend.unavailable: Revocation list unreachable after retries: SOURCE UNAVAILABLE (manual task)
legend.absent: Required uploader signature absent: a finding, not a label

verification.legendUploader: A valid uploader signature never makes a document verified. Only the issuer's signature or an official source can.
verification.legendAnchor: {anchor} is the synthetic demo root. In production the chain must build to the CCA root.
verification.noDocuments: No documents to verify in this case.
